teacher.uncertainHint: Practised, but too thinly to judge. A cell is judged once it carries the weight of about {count, plural, one {# typed answer} other {# typed answers}}.
teacher.strongEmpty: Nothing has cleared the bar yet.
teacher.uncertainEmpty: Every cell that has been practised has enough behind it.
teacher.empty: No practice has been recorded yet, so there is nothing to say.
teacher.unavailable: The profile could not be loaded.
teacher.unknownNote: “Not recorded” is a real answer: an exercise says what it trains only when the course says so.

worthALook.title: Worth a look this week

reason.forgets: You get this right in the moment and it fades within days. Come back to it sooner rather than learning it again.
reason.never-knew: This one is steady, and steadily off — it is the rule itself that needs another look, not more repetitions.
reason.watch: Nothing wrong here; it is simply the slowest of what you are practising, and something has to come first.
reason.unknown: This one is shaky, and nothing recorded yet says whether it slips away or never quite landed.

worthALook.thin: Too few attempts to say anything yet — three more and this turns into real feedback.
